data.title: Bitcoin price holds above $64,000 as traders brace for upcoming Fed decision
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin prices were closing in on $64,000 on Sunday lifted by pre-Fed positioning and a notable surge in options market activity as traders bet on a significant move targeting toward $72,000 by the end of July, following this week’s Federal Reserve meeting.
data.keywords: Options traders, trading market, Bitcoin rising, weekend trading
